workload_series: calibration-workloads/1 and a10-calibration-oracle/1; original public-v1 remains smoke/correctness only; explicit phase-specific anchor mapping and new ELF identities

sampling.raw_encoding: calibrated-raw/1; complete owned sample/clock values reused only after equality of each independently captured and P0-validated value, never verdict reuse
sampling.retention_scheduling: VM-local synchronous compressed retention; bounded owned driver buffer (256 frames or 8 MiB), acknowledged completely before the next timer after each flush; pilot/warmup/control boundaries flush; no overlapped compression/guest measurement
sampling.repetition_calibration: pilot minimum for bounded planning; final minimum over every accepted warmup/calibration interval after BOTH warmup gates; ceiling of 1.5 times minimum sample work, frozen across independent sessions

statistics.mad: median absolute deviation from sample median
statistics.bootstrap: percentile median, independent sampling with replacement
statistics.relative_ci_half_width_meaning: evidence sufficiency only, NOT a regression threshold
statistics.three_session_calibration: same percentile median bootstrap over three independent session medians; identical confidence/resamples/seed/half-width sufficiency target, never a speed gate

requires: known physical host with native before/after boot UUID and boot time
stable observed native identity, power source and low-power settings
local Unix Docker endpoint linked to actual inspected Colima provider/configuration
same actual daemon, VM boot, live container ID/start/configuration/resources; cgroup-v2 namespace-root inspection only, positive parsed cpu.max/memory.max
actual measurement thread VM affinity; native library children own readback; CLI explicitly derived initial caller-thread affinity inheritance only, no direct/sustained child readback
all independent-session oracle, sample, warmup, clock, overhead and noise gates
compatibility.unobserved_controls: retain original absence reasons; NEVER compare nulls/reasons as equality operands or substitute power settings/VM affinity for physical DVFS/affinity
limitations: physical macOS affinity may be UNOBSERVED/UNCONTROLLED
physical governor and turbo may be UNOBSERVED/UNCONTROLLED
vCPU affinity does not prove physical-core mapping
power source and low-power settings are not frequency/governor/turbo readback
no equal physical scheduler or DVFS state, controlled-host, cross-allocation or cross-runner guarantee
collector/checksum evidence is not cryptographic host attestation
